text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, this is the flowerbed Air Groove was talking about! 
Alright, let’s get started. Ikuno, you ready?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everything’s set. Air Groove is busy handling matters with 
the 'TCGC', so we’ll take care of the flowerbed in her place.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I’ve memorized all the steps and key points for this. 
If you have any questions, feel free to ask me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wow, look at you, all prepared! You really 
do love looking after everyone, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But when it comes to tending to plants I’m probably 
better at it♪ After all, I learned how to do it from my 
grandma, so you can rely on me too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of, they should be asking questions. 
Hey, everyone! Get over here already!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! We're on our way! Come on, 
Kraft, don’t just stand there—hustle!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-I’m sorry! It’s just... the flowers Air Groove 
raised are just so beautiful. I got a little distracted!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Well, I’m not surprised considering Air Groove’s 
a legend on the Tiara route! Of course, Kraft would be 
drawn in. She’s always been like this, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
This isn’t the time for your musings, 
Heart. We should hurry over as well.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And you’re as serious as ever. But fine, let’s go.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Kraft, Cesario, Heart, and Messiah. 
Alright, everyone’s here. Let’s get to work.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um! Sorry for the sudden interruption! But 
with so many brilliant Tiara route Uma Musume 
gathered together, I just couldn’t pass this chance up!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: If you wouldn’t mind, please allow me to cover this!

text_block_list.name: Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Heart, you came to grab the gardening tools, right? 
Um, do you mind if we helped out? Only if it’s okay, of course!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh, thanks♪ Actually, I was just about to ask someone for a favor!

text_block_list.name: Uma Musume B
text_block_list.text:
Yay! That means we get to work closely with Heart ♡ 
Just tell us what to do and we’ll do our best!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(This level of popularity! And the fact that she’s 
an exchange student from America only adds to 
her aura. She has the true essence of a Queen!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: れじゃ……Umph!……で、後は――

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, then... Nngh! Now, you two, grab that one, 
the one over there... and the box on the shelf please! 
Just stack them on top of this one for me, okay? Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Uma Musume A & B
text_block_list.text: That’s all you want us to do?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(And on top of that—she’s incredibly disciplined and self-driven! 
Such a noble spirit... what an inspiring Uma Musume!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Haa. "Mix mulch, red soil aggregate, and black soil in approximately 
a 3:6:1 ratio. Then adjust the mixture to allow for a slight dampness—
enough to hold together when gently squeezed..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the potting soil is complete! Well done. 
Your precise and diligent approach is truly impressive!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, I appreciate it. I doubt this makes 
for a particularly exciting story, though.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, trust me, this is more than enough! Still, your 
meticulous style reminds me so much of your mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well, she has always been my guiding 
light, so that is the highest of compliments.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I will continue to steadily and surely build on this foundation.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Just as well-prepared soil nurtures a 
flourishing future, I, too, will one day, flourish.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
( With Heart and Messiah covered, 
it’s time for the two Tiara route rivals!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, for the last time! That flower is really tricky 
to handle! I told you to just leave it to me, didn’t I?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
But! I came here to help with the flowerbed, too! 
I want to do my part, so please let me try!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Apologies, Sweep, but Kraft can be quite stubborn. 
How about this, let her and I handle it together? 
Would you be willing to trust us if that were the case?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, fine! But I’m going to inspect it later, 
and I won’t go easy on you either! Got it?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Understood! Thank you for trusting us!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thanks for backing me up, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Don’t mention it. I could just tell how eager you are to help with this.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course I am! After all, it’s an honor to be 
helping out Sweep and Ikuno, especially since Air 
Groove herself entrusted them with this!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
They’re all my seniors on the Tiara route. 
If I didn’t give it my all, I’d be letting everyone down, including myself!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
These flowers really are beautiful. There’s so many 
different colors, and they’re all in full bloom. In fact, 
they all kind of remind me of my seniors as well!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to bloom like that too one day. Bright and bold, 
enough so that no one will ever forget me!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Hmph. That unwavering spirit of yours, really is...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ahem, anyway, I feel the exact same toward our seniors. 
It’s thanks to those great champions before us that we can
even stand here today.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So I, too, will become a pillar for the future. And as someone 
chasing after the same dreams as you, understand that this 
is a race I will not lose.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Well I won’t lose to you, Cesario. 
Not to you, Messiah, or Heart! Alright, let’s do this!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, this is just... just incredible! The Tiara route—
the stage where these brilliant Uma Musume shine!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Uh, what’s up with her? She’s, like, super hyped up... is she okay?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
She’s probably fine. Besides, I must admit, 
I can understand where she is coming from.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara races we once ran. I can’t help but wonder 
what kind of stories these girls will write on that grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, I guess I might be a little 
excited to see how their stories unfold!
